make_or_buy_basis: A supplier-tailored metro gangway bellows seals the passenger connection without becoming part of the structural draw/buff load path.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: supplier finish/protection accepted by OSR evidence pack
material_spec.form_factor: preassembled supplier module with installation kit
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier specification plus project interface, safety, EMC/fire, and lifecycle evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: COTS/BID component class matched to OSR envelope
material_spec.nominal_section: mass, volume, mounting datum, service clearance, and connector envelope frozen by RFQ drawing
material_spec.traceability: serialised CoC, datasheet, revision, and incoming inspection record

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: BID supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: The vehicle-specific bellows, bridge, turntable, clamp and open-end drawbar geometry remains to be engineered with the supplier.
supplier_anchor.localisation: Bellows textile, panels and bridge pieces may localise after fire, fatigue, water, passenger load, pinch-gap and full-motion testing to the frozen clamp frames.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
